title: David Brings the Ark of God and the Death of Uzzah
description: David gathers all Israel to bring the Ark of God from Kiriath-Jearim. But when Uzzah reaches out his hand toward the ark because the oxen stumble, the Lord strikes him down. David is filled with fear and leaves the ark in the house of Obed-Edom for three months, where the Lord blesses his household.
